title: Chromium remote debugging used for cookie theft

searches.name: Windows Chromium Browser Remote Debugging Enabled
searches.spl:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly`
  count min(_time) as firstTime
        max(_time) as lastTime

from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where

Processes.process_name IN ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "brave.exe", "opera.exe", "vivaldi.exe")
Processes.process IN ("*--remote-debugging-port*", "*--remote-debugging-pipe*")
NOT Processes.process="*--type=*"

by Processes.action Processes.dest Processes.original_file_name Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_exec
   Processes.parent_process_guid Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path
   Processes.process Processes.process_exec Processes.process_guid Processes.process_hash Processes.process_id
   Processes.process_integrity_level Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.user Processes.user_id
   Processes.vendor_product

| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT (parent_process_name=process_name AND like(process, "%--do-not-de-elevate%"))
| eval debug_mode=case(like(process, "%--remote-debugging-pipe%"), "pipe", match(process, "--remote-debugging-port=0(\s|$)"), "port 0", true(), "fixed port")
| eval alt_profile=if(like(process, "%--user-data-dir%"), "yes", "no")
| eval hidden=if(match(process, "(?i)--headless|--window-position=-\d{4,}"), "yes", "no")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `windows_chromium_browser_remote_debugging_enabled_filter`

searches.name: Windows Non-Browser Process Connection To Chromium DevTools Port
searches.spl:
`sysmon` EventCode=3 Initiated="true" DestinationIp IN ("127.0.0.1", "::1") DestinationPort IN (9222, 9223, 9224, 9225, 9226, 9227, 9228, 9229)
  NOT process_name IN ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "brave.exe", "opera.exe", "vivaldi.exe")
  | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(DestinationPort) as dest_port values(DestinationIp) as dest_ip values(User) as user
    BY Computer process_name Image ProcessGuid ProcessId
  | rename Computer as dest, Image as process_path, ProcessGuid as process_guid, ProcessId as process_id
  | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
  | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
  | `windows_non_browser_process_connection_to_chromium_devtools_port_filter`

searches.name: Existing ESCU: Headless Browser Usage (869ba261)
searches.note: The existing analytic requires --headless AND --disable-gpu. It matches only the benign --dump-dom negative and none of the remote-debugging launches.
searches.spl:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("Chrome.exe","Brave.exe", "Opera.exe", "Vivaldi.exe", "msedge.exe") (Processes.process="*--headless*" AND Processes.process="*--disable-gpu*")
by Processes.action Processes.dest Processes.original_file_name Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_exec Processes.parent_process_guid Processes.parent_process_id Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process Processes.process_exec Processes.process_guid Processes.process_hash Processes.process_id Processes.process_integrity_level Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.user Processes.user_id Processes.vendor_product | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `headless_browser_usage_filter`
